newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Dunlop rises on plant re-opening.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Dunlop rises on plant re-opening.

text.p: Shares of tyre maker Dunlop Nigeria Plc rose by more than two percent on Thursday after it reopened its factory which was shut due to a workers protest on Tuesday.
The shares closed 30 kobo up at 10.70 naira on the Nigerian stock market on restored investors confidence, traders said.
"The way management promptly restored order in one day impressed the market," said one.
Dunlop said in a statement business reopened on Wednesday after returning workers undertook to maintain industrial peace.
Tuesday's action over a pay rise dispute led to molestation of management who called in the police. Some arrests were made.
The workers were offered a pay rise of 20-40 percent instead of 100 percent they sought and those who were unhappy with the deal allegedly went on rampage.
Expectations of better yield has seen Dunlop shares rise to 10.70 naira from 7.40 naira at the beginning of the year.
